items.title: MUSS: A Multi-scale and Sequence-based Model for Single-cell Gene Regulation
items.title_zh: MUSS：一个用于单细胞基因调控的多尺度且基于序列的模型
items.summary_zh: 在单细胞中建模基因调控需要跨调控尺度联合表示DNA序列、染色质可及性和基因表达。基于序列的模型捕获DNA水平的调控语法，但通常缺乏细胞水平的分辨率，而许多单细胞组学模型将基因和峰表示为固定词汇的标记，而没有其底层序列。在这里，我们提出了MUSS，一个基于序列的单细胞基因调控多尺度模型，同时保留DNA水平和细胞水平的分辨率。MUSS使用冻结的预训练序列编码器从DNA推导峰和基因水平的表示，并通过峰-峰自注意力和距离偏置的峰-基因相互作用进行整合。峰掩码语言建模随后在配对的scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq上训练，将这些表示与细胞特异性调控状态对齐。在基因表达预测、增强子-基因连接、基序引导的调控优先级排序和零样本细胞聚类方面，MUSS相对于基于序列和单细胞组学的基线取得了强劲性能。它进一步预测任务训练期间未见过的基因和峰的表达。这些结果支持基于序列的多尺度表示用于解码细胞类型特异性调控

extra.description: Modeling gene regulation in single cells requires jointly representing DNA sequence, chromatin accessibility, and gene expression across regulatory scales. Sequence-based models capture DNA-level regulatory grammar but often lack cell-level resolution, whereas many single-cell omics models represent genes and peaks as fixed-vocabulary tokens without their underlying sequence. Here, we present MUSS, a sequence-based multi-scale model for single-cell gene regulation that preserves both DNA-level and cell-level resolution. MUSS derives peak- and gene-level representations from DNA using a frozen pre-trained sequence encoder and integrates them through peak-peak self-attention and distance-biased peak-gene interactions. Peak masked language modeling followed by training on paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq aligns these representations with cell-specific regulatory states. Across gene expression prediction, enhancer-gene linking, motif-guided regulatory prioritization, and zero-shot cell clustering, MUSS achieves strong performance against sequence-based and single-cell omics baselines. It further predicts expression for genes and peaks unseen during task training. These results support sequence-grounded, multi-scale representations for decoding cell-type-specific regulatory programs. Code, datasets, and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Lotfollahi-lab/MUSS_neurips26.

items.title: Attribution-based diagnostics for single-cell foundation models
items.title_zh: 基于归因的单细胞基础模型诊断
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA基础模型（scFM）越来越多地用于计算机生物发现，但仅凭预测性能无法揭示其决策依赖的是具有生物学意义的信号还是模型特定的捷径。我们系统研究了两个任务中下游预测的事后归因：使用预训练Cell2Sentence和scGPT模型进行细胞类型注释，以及在受控设置中使用scGPT+STATE进行扰动预测。对于细胞注释，我们使用归因评估预测是否依赖已确立的标记基因，以及它们的相关性如何随模型架构、表达排名和周围细胞上下文变化。对于扰动预测，我们在合成设置中将归因模式与已知调控真值比较，以评估它们对模型学习计算的揭示。在这些任务中，归因揭示了生物特征使用、上下文交互、不同输入通路的贡献、学习进展、与预测质量的关联，以及标准性能指标未完全捕捉的潜在陷阱。使用完整和有限调控知识的实验进一步表明，从归因得出的结论强烈依赖于生物参考、基线和零模型的选择。总之，这些发现凸显了归因作为灵活事后诊断的价值

extra.description: Single-cell RNA foundation models (scFMs) are increasingly used for in-silico biological discovery, yet predictive performance alone does not reveal whether their decisions rely on biologically meaningful signals or model-specific shortcuts. We systematically investigate post-hoc attribution of downstream predictions across two tasks: cell-type annotation using pretrained Cell2Sentence and scGPT models, and perturbation prediction using scGPT+STATE in a controlled setting. For cell annotation, we use attribution to assess whether predictions rely on established marker genes and how their relevance varies with model architecture, expression rank, and the surrounding cellular context. For perturbation prediction, we compare attribution patterns with known regulatory ground-truth in a synthetic setting to assess what they reveal about the model's learned computations. Across these tasks, attribution reveals biological feature use, contextual interactions, contributions from different input pathways, learning progression, associations with prediction quality, and potential pitfalls that are not fully captured by standard performance metrics. Experiments with complete and limited regulatory knowledge further demonstrate that conclusions drawn from attribution depend strongly on the choice of biological reference, baseline, and null model. Together, these findings highlight the value of attribution as a flexible post-hoc diagnostic for understanding model behavior, identifying potential issues, and informing the development of scFMs.

items.title: Guiding Data Allocation for Robust Subpopulation Generalization
items.title_zh: 指导数据分配以实现鲁棒的亚群泛化
items.summary_zh: 机器学习模型通常在训练数据中达到很高的平均准确率，但由于亚群偏移而在测试数据上表现不佳。一种常见的以数据为中心的解决方案是强制实现平衡的亚组比例，但完全平衡可能代价高昂、不可行，且并不总是必要。在这项工作中，我们研究平衡训练数据是否是实现鲁棒亚群泛化的唯一最优配置。我们扩展了一个高斯特征模型框架，从理论上刻画了跨一般训练亚组分布的性能景观。我们表明，多种配置，包括显著不平衡的配置，可以表现得与平衡配置相当。我们进一步推导了基于梯度的方向来调整亚组比例，以更有效地提高调整后准确率和最差组准确率。这些发现表明，策略性地分配数据比简单的平衡提供了一条更灵活、更有原则的通往鲁棒性能的路径。代码可在https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/subpop-data-allocation获取。

extra.description: Machine learning models often achieve high average accuracy in the training data while performing poorly on test data due to subpopulation shift. A common data-centric solution is to enforce balanced subgroup proportions, but full balance can be costly, infeasible, and not always necessary. In this work, we study whether balanced training data is the unique optimal configuration for robust subpopulation generalization. We extend a Gaussian feature-model framework to theoretically characterize the performance landscape across general training subgroup distributions. We show that multiple configurations, including substantially imbalanced ones, can perform comparably to the balanced one. We further derive gradient-based directions for adjusting subgroup proportions to improve adjusted accuracy and worst-group accuracy more efficiently. These findings suggest that strategically allocating data offers a more flexible and principled path to robust performance than simple balancing. The code is available at https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/subpop-data-allocation.

items.title: Fisher-Glass Learning: Classification Bounds and Subpopulation Audits
items.title_zh: Fisher-Glass学习：分类边界与亚群审计
items.summary_zh: 当背景线索发生变化而不改变正确标签时，准确的分类器可能会失败。仅凭预测性能无法量化在考虑此类 nuisance 变化后还保留多少任务信息。在这里，我们扩展了Fisher-glass框架，将 nuisance 调整后的信息与局部分类难度和亚群审计联系起来。我们在明确的区分性和决策分离条件下推导了局部 minimax 超额分类风险的下界，以及考虑估计误差和正则化的统计审计。在Waterbirds上，基于任务-背景对齐的特征诊断选择了一个被准确分类的组，选择在留出评估之前冻结。在五个训练种子中，保留提取的鸟前景和标签的背景替换在背景类型保留时产生93.2%的准确率，在背景类型改变时产生40.6%的准确率，受控差异为52.6个百分点。另外，使用任务标签和固定 nuisance 方向进行搜索，识别出一个独立评估的群体，其成员加权准确率为98.8%，估计的投影预测Fisher信息较低。训练和获取实验表

extra.description: Accurate classifiers can fail when background cues change without altering the correct labels. Predictive performance alone does not quantify how much task information remains after accounting for such nuisance variation. Here we extend the Fisher-glass framework to connect nuisance-adjusted information with local classification difficulty and subpopulation auditing. We derive lower bounds on local minimax excess classification risk under explicit distinguishability and decision-separation conditions, alongside statistical audits accounting for estimation error and regularization. On Waterbirds, a feature-based diagnostic of task-background alignment selects an accurately classified group, with selection frozen before held-out evaluation. Across five training seeds, background replacements preserving the extracted bird foreground and labels yield 93.2% accuracy when background type is preserved and 40.6% when it changes, a controlled difference of 52.6 percentage points. Separately, search using task labels and a fixed nuisance direction identifies an independently evaluated population with 98.8% membership-weighted accuracy and low estimated projected predictive Fisher information. Training and acquisition experiments show that information gains and predictive gains can diverge. These findings support joint assessment of predictive performance, information under declared nuisance models and controlled sensitivity when diagnosing vulnerability and evaluating model improvements.

items.title: Reproducible quantum clustering for single-cell transcriptome atlases
items.title_zh: 用于单细胞转录组图谱的可复现量子聚类
items.summary_zh: 当前的单细胞聚类流程丢弃了大多数基因，并且在不同随机种子下可能产生不一致的聚类。我们介绍了KQE-2，一个无需训练的混合量子-经典框架，用于可复现的全转录组聚类。KQE-2将细胞映射到无纠缠的量子态，使得能够在经典硬件上进行精确的特征评估，并在量子处理器上直接检查。在理论上，我们证明了消除纠缠是局部限制单量子比特特征方差的必要且充分条件。在实践中，虽然重新训练scVI使14%的细胞发生偏移并改变了稀有类型标记和药物靶点，但KQE-2在多次运行中提供了相同的生物学结果。在标准高变基因上，仅量子编码就将发育中皮层的准确率从0.61提高到0.79。KQE-2可在一台服务器上扩展到1140万个细胞核，在十个完整图谱中的八个上优于所比较的方法（在两个上处于最佳方法的运行间范围内），并且即使在标准下游聚类下也在六个上领先。

extra.description: Current single-cell clustering pipelines discard most genes and can yield inconsistent clusters across random seeds. We introduce KQE-2, a training-free hybrid quantum-classical framework for reproducible whole-transcriptome clustering. KQE-2 maps cells into entanglement-free quantum states, enabling exact feature evaluation on classical hardware and direct checks on a quantum processor. Theoretically, we prove that removing entanglement is necessary and sufficient to bound single-qubit feature variance locally. Practically, while retraining scVI shifted 14% of cells and altered rare-type markers and drug targets, KQE-2 delivered identical biology across runs. On standard highly variable genes, the quantum encoding alone raised accuracy on a developing cortex from 0.61 to 0.79. KQE-2 scales to 11.4 million nuclei on one server, outperforming the compared methods on eight of ten complete atlases (and within the best method's run-to-run range on two), and leads on six even under standard downstream clustering.

items.title: Characterizing Underrepresentation when Generalizing Causal Survival Estimates
items.title_zh: 刻画因果生存估计泛化时的代表性不足
items.summary_zh: 随机试验结果通常被推广到更广泛的目标人群，以为医学和公共政策决策提供信息。当试验样本与目标人群不一致时，广义效应估计可能导致次优决策。我们在时间-事件设置中刻画了试验队列中代表性不足的目标亚组。在这里，代表性不足以两种不同方式出现：基线代表性不足，即某个亚组的协变量特征在试验中相对于目标人群较为罕见；以及时变代表性不足，即差异性删失在随访过程中侵蚀某个亚组。现有的诊断要么混淆了这些机制，要么仅适用于基线情况。我们表明，有效泛化估计器的渐近方差允许一种分解，其中只有两项在代表性减弱时可能发散：一个捕捉基线错位的抽样权重项和一个捕捉差异性随访丢失的删失权重项。因此，代表性不足的亚组就是那些广义估计不精确的亚组，而两项中较大的一项给出了责任通道。我们在TRACE（删失数据的时间Rashomon分析）中使用这种分解，它结合了自归一化方差目标和基于树的搜索来定位代表性不足的亚组，将每个亚组归因于基线

extra.description: Randomized trial findings are routinely generalized to broader target populations to inform decisions in medicine and public policy. When the trial sample is misaligned with the target population, generalized effect estimates can yield suboptimal decisions. We characterize the target subgroups that are underrepresented in the trial cohort in time-to-event settings. Here, underrepresentation arises in two distinct ways: baseline underrepresentation, when a subgroup's covariate profile is rare in the trial relative to the target, and time-varying underrepresentation, when differential censoring erodes a subgroup over follow-up. Existing diagnostics either conflate these mechanisms or apply only to the baseline case. We show that the asymptotic variance of the efficient generalizability estimator admits a decomposition in which only two terms can diverge as representation weakens: a sampling-weight term capturing baseline misalignment and a censoring-weight term capturing differential loss to follow-up. Underrepresented subgroups are therefore those with imprecise generalized estimates, and the larger of the two terms gives the responsible channel. We use this decomposition in TRACE (Temporal Rashomon Analysis of CEnsored data), which combines a self-normalized variance objective with a tree-based search to localize underrepresented subgroups, attribute each to baseline mismatch or censoring, and find the follow-up intervals where censoring drives the variance inflation. We solve the joint problem with a parametric dynamic program nested inside a Rashomon ensemble of near-optimal trees. In synthetic benchmarks, TRACE recovers the planted underrepresented regions. In a case study generalizing the National Job Training Partnership Act (JTPA) Study to U.S. JTPA-eligible adults, restricting to reliably generalizable subgroups narrows the 95% confidence interval for the refined estimand by 60%.

items.title: HELICS: Biobank-scale Conditional Synthetic Genome Generation via Latent Flow Matching
items.title_zh: HELICS：通过潜在流匹配进行生物样本库规模的条件合成基因组生成
items.summary_zh: 个体水平基因型数据支撑遗传发现、疾病风险建模和治疗开发，然而许多关键场景仍数据有限，包括代表性不足的祖先群体、罕见或不平衡疾病队列以及受限访问的生物样本库。条件合成基因组生成将支持隐私感知的基准测试、模拟和数据增强，但需要学习数十万至数千万相关单核苷酸多态性（SNPs，即DNA变异位点）上的超高维离散分布。我们引入HELICS：通过潜在插值条件合成的高保真生成，一个无定相潜在流匹配框架，用于从生物样本库规模基因型数据进行全基因组SNP水平生成。HELICS用卷积自编码器对染色体进行标记化，将>600K SNPs缩减为4,096个连续潜在标记，并在拼接的多染色体潜在表示上训练参数化条件流匹配的transformer模型。在英国生物样本库超过417K基因组上训练，HELICS无需单倍型定相即可生成全基因组常见变异合成队列，并比现有基于单倍型的模拟器更忠实于真实基因型，包括外部评估中高等位基因频

extra.description: Individual-level genotype data underpin genetic discovery, disease-risk modeling, and therapeutic development, yet many critical settings remain data-limited, including underrepresented ancestries, rare or imbalanced disease cohorts, and restricted-access biobanks. Conditional synthetic genome generation would support privacy-aware benchmarking, simulation, and data augmentation, but requires learning an ultra-high-dimensional discrete distribution over hundreds of thousands to tens of millions of correlated single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), or sites of DNA variation. We introduce HELICS: High-fidelity gEneration via Latent Interpolant Conditional Synthesis, a phasing-free latent flow matching framework for genome-wide SNP-level generation from biobank-scale genotype data. HELICS tokenizes chromosomes with convolutional autoencoders, reducing >600K SNPs to 4,096 continuous latent tokens, and trains a transformer parameterized conditional flow matching model over the concatenated multi-chromosome latent representation. Trained on over 417K genomes in the UK Biobank, HELICS generates genome-wide common-variant synthetic cohorts without haplotype phasing and achieves stronger fidelity to real genotypes than existing haplotype-based simulators, including high allele-frequency agreement in external evaluation and superior preservation of local and long-range SNP correlation structure. Conditioning on ancestry and genetic liability summaries enables targeted generation across genetic risk profiles; in perturbation analyses, by increasing the conditioned disease trait liability, HELICS induces SNP-level dosage changes in generated genomes that are highly correlated with published association weights. HELICS provides a scalable generative modeling framework for SNP-level genome data and a path toward conditional synthetic cohorts for data-limited genetic studies.

items.title: stMIND: Learning multiscale interaction dynamics from spatial-temporal transcriptomics
items.title_zh: stMIND：从时空转录组学习多尺度相互作用动力学
items.summary_zh: 局部细胞邻域内以及跨更广泛组织尺度的相互作用共同调控发育和再生过程中的分子状态转变和形态发生。虽然时间分辨空间转录组学同时分析基因表达和空间坐标，但破坏性测序在每个时间点采样不同的细胞，留下中间轨迹和多尺度细胞间相互作用未被观察。在我们相互作用的平均场神经随机微分方程框架基础上，我们提出了stMIND（时空多尺度相互作用神经动力学），一个连续时间生成框架，从非匹配的时空快照推断耦合的分子、空间和增殖动力学。stMIND将细胞表达速度向量/漂移分解为三个可解释的算子：细胞内在程序、局部图差分注意力算子（在共同演化的物理半径内聚合相对表达差异和空间几何），以及非局部平均场注意力算子（捕捉超出紧邻邻域的远程群体背景）。通过随细胞迁移一起演化动态空间邻域，并强制内在漂移和相互作用驱动漂移之间的正交性，stMIND通过联合表达-位置空间中的最优传输解析尺度特异性细胞间影响。在蝾螈和斑马鱼基准中，st

extra.description: Interactions within local cellular neighborhoods and across broader tissue scales jointly govern molecular state transitions and morphogenesis during development and regeneration. While time-resolved spatial transcriptomics simultaneously profiles gene expression and spatial coordinates, destructive sequencing samples distinct cells at each time point, leaving intermediate trajectories and multiscale intercellular interactions unobserved. Building upon our interacting mean-field neural stochastic differential equation framework, we present stMIND (Spatiotemporal Multiscale Interaction Neural Dynamics), a continuous-time generative framework that infers coupled molecular, spatial, and proliferation dynamics from unmatched spatiotemporal snapshots. stMIND decomposes cellular expression velocity vector/drift into three interpretable operators: a cell-intrinsic program, a local graph-difference attention operator that aggregates relative expression differences and spatial geometry within a co-evolving physical radius, and a nonlocal mean-field attention operator that captures long-range population context beyond the immediate neighborhood. By evolving dynamic spatial neighborhoods alongside cellular migration and enforcing orthogonality between intrinsic and interaction-driven drifts, stMIND resolves scale-specific intercellular influences through optimal transport in joint expression-position space. In axolotl and zebrafish benchmarks, stMIND leads in expression prediction, anatomical consistency and spatial coherence. Ablations confirm the need to combine disjoint local and nonlocal operators. It reveals a regenerative transition in axolotl telencephalon 10 to 15 days after injury, with a drift energy surge followed by nonlocal dominance and local counterbalance varying by cell type in reactive ependymoglial niches. It tracks developmental vector fields across zebrafish stages.

items.title: Publications as benchmarks: auditing AI agents on spatial transcriptomics alignment
items.title_zh: 出版物作为基准：审计AI智能体在空间转录组对齐上的表现
items.summary_zh: AI智能体正越来越多地自动化数据分析，但负责任的采用需要可靠的性能评估，这在专业科学领域成本高昂。我们引入了一个框架，将科学出版物转化为AI智能体可审计的基准，并展示了其在空间转录组对齐任务上的应用。在121个任务、16个基线方法和六个AI智能体中，最佳智能体（GPT-6-Astra和Gemini-4-Argon）在80%的任务上匹配或优于所有基线，通常使用令人惊讶的简单启发式方法。智能体性能对提示和访问预安装包具有鲁棒性。基准构建还揭示了先前工作中的错误和当前评估指标中的捷径。最后，我们表明智能体生成的解决方案可以蒸馏成一个可重用的程序，在未见数据上排名前10%的基线方法。我们的框架提供了一种可扩展的方式，通过利用和压力测试现有论文和指标来评估专业科学领域中的AI智能体。

extra.description: AI agents are increasingly automating data analysis, but responsible adoption requires reliable performance evaluation, which is costly in specialized scientific domains. We introduce a framework that translates scientific publications into auditable benchmarks for AI agents and demonstrate its use on spatial transcriptomics alignment tasks. Across 121 tasks, 16 baseline methods, and six AI agents, the best agents (GPT-6-Astra and Gemini-4-Argon) matched or outperformed all baselines on 80% of tasks, often using surprisingly simple heuristics. Agent performance was robust to prompting and access to pre-installed packages. Benchmark construction also uncovered errors in prior work and shortcuts in current evaluation metrics. Finally, we show that agent-generated solutions can be distilled into a reusable program that ranks in the top 10% of baseline methods on unseen data. Our framework offers a scalable way to evaluate AI agents in specialized scientific domains by leveraging and stress-testing existing papers and metrics.

items.title: Synchronized Optimal Transport Reconstructs Coupled Transcriptomic and Chromatin Dynamics
items.title_zh: 同步最优传输重建耦合的转录组与染色质动态
items.summary_zh: 跨发育阶段收集的单细胞 RNA 和 ATAC 数据提供了转录和调控状态的时间进程快照。由于测序是破坏性的，这些快照之间的轨迹必须从独立采样的细胞群体中推断。现有方法通常在单一模态中推断连续动态，或在共享表示中整合 RNA 和 ATAC。在此我们提出跨组学对齐轨迹推断（COATI），它将非平衡同步动态最优传输扩展为时间依赖的跨模态映射，以在不同 RNA 和 ATAC 状态空间中重建耦合轨迹。我们在合成基准和四个发育数据集上使用留出阶段重建和谱系分析评估了 COATI。COATI 改善了留出阶段细胞群体的重建，包括恢复细胞类型内的染色质状态异质性，并更好地保留了发育谱系关系。非平衡形式允许推断群体质量变化，这些变化被证明与早期阶段的 DNA 复制程序和发育后期的谱系成熟程序相关。耦合轨迹使得分析发育过程中谱系特异的转录和染色质变化及其时间关系成为可能。COATI 推断的谱系响应与独立的 CRI

extra.description: Single-cell RNA and ATAC data collected across developmental stages provide time-course snapshots of transcriptional and regulatory states. Since sequencing is destructive, trajectories between these snapshots must be inferred from independently sampled cell populations. Existing approaches typically infer continuous dynamics in a single modality or integrate RNA and ATAC in a shared representation. Here we present Cross-Omics Aligned Trajectory Inference (COATI), which extends unbalanced synchronized dynamical optimal transport to time-dependent cross-modal maps for reconstructing coupled trajectories in distinct RNA and ATAC state spaces. We evaluated COATI on synthetic benchmarks and four developmental datasets using held-out-stage reconstruction and lineage analyses. COATI improved reconstruction of cell populations at held-out stages, including recovery of chromatin-state heterogeneity within cell types, and better preserved developmental lineage relationships. The unbalanced formulation allows the inference of population mass changes, which were shown to associate with DNA-replication programs at early stages and lineage-maturation programs later in development. The coupled trajectories enabled analysis of lineage-specific transcriptional and chromatin changes and their temporal relationships during development. Lineage responses inferred by COATI agreed with independent CRISPR perturbation results, and the inferred regulatory patterns were consistent with independent epigenetic data.

items.title: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
items.title_zh: HistoTx：在不同空间转录组学分辨率下，通过自监督学习对H&E图像和空间转录组学进行早期融合
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学绘制组织切片上的基因表达图谱，当与全切片图像整合时，可联合捕获形态结构和分子活动，从而提供组织生物学的丰富多模态视图。将空间转录组学与WSI结合的ML方法通常通过对比对齐或对病理基础模型进行监督微调，学习从形态特征到分子谱的映射。在这两种情况下，转录组学都作为训练信号而非真正的输入模态，使推理从根本上由图像驱动。我们提出一种早期融合视觉Transformer架构，其中转录组token以任意空间分辨率构建，与图像块token合并，并通过共享Transformer堆栈联合处理，以实现深度跨模态交互。从预训练的纯视觉病理基础模型出发，我们通过在配对的图像和空间转录组学数据上继续自监督预训练来训练HistoTx，并证明：1）在仅使用图像进行推理时，性能在大多数任务上与基线持平，同时在本质上受益于分子知识的任务（如基因表达预测）上有所提升；2）当推理时两种模态均可用时，联合提供图像和转录

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.

items.title: Synaptic Dendritic Neuron Model (scDNM) for Cell Type Classification in Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Data
items.title_zh: 突触树突神经元模型（scDNM）用于单细胞RNA测序数据中的细胞类型分类
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中的细胞类型分类具有挑战性，因为存在高维度、稀疏性和转录相似的细胞类型。我们开发了scDNM，这是树突神经元模型的改编版，结合了可学习的突触阈值、监督基因池、分阶段训练和集成预测。从Paul15、PBMC3k和Nestorowa数据集构建了六个二分类任务。所有模型均使用无泄漏的嵌套交叉验证进行评估，特征选择、缩放和超参数调优独立于外部测试折进行。scDNM在六个任务中的三个中排名第一（包括一次并列），并取得了最佳平均准确率排名（2.00），其次是XGBoost（2.75）、随机森林（3.33）、逻辑回归（3.33）和SVM（3.58）。在六类PBMC3k实验中，scDNM达到了95.997%的准确率和0.944的宏F1，而SingleR为94.243%和0.914。Garnett仅返回Unknown标签，被视为零覆盖的技术结果。消融分析支持了树突和

extra.description: Cell type classification in single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data is challenging because of high dimensionality, sparsity, and transcriptionally similar cell types. We developed scDNM, an adaptation of the dendritic neuron model incorporating learnable synaptic thresholds, a supervised gene pool, staged training, and ensemble prediction. Six binary classification tasks were constructed from the Paul15, PBMC3k, and Nestorowa datasets. All models were evaluated using leakage-free nested cross-validation, with feature selection, scaling, and hyperparameter tuning performed independently of the outer test folds. scDNM ranked first in three of six tasks (including one tie) and achieved the best mean accuracy rank (2.00), followed by XGBoost (2.75), Random Forest (3.33), logistic regression (3.33), and SVM (3.58). In a six-class PBMC3k experiment, scDNM achieved 95.997% accuracy and 0.944 macro-F1, compared with 94.243% and 0.914 for SingleR. Garnett returned only Unknown labels and was treated as a zero-coverage technical outcome. Ablation analysis supported the contributions of dendrites and synaptic thresholds. However, XGBoost achieved higher mean binary-task accuracy (96.20% versus 95.32% for scDNM), and across-task rank differences were not statistically significant. These findings demonstrate that scDNM is competitive for scRNA-seq cell type classification, although broader independent validation is required.

items.title: Coupling cellular trajectories and RNA kinetics on continuous expression manifolds with ManifoldVelo
items.title_zh: 在连续表达流形上耦合细胞轨迹与RNA动力学：ManifoldVelo
items.summary_zh: 从静态单细胞转录组中联合恢复伪时间和RNA速率，需要协调全局轨迹结构与局部表达变化，尤其是在复杂周期和分支分化中。在此我们介绍ManifoldVelo，一个拓扑条件框架，联合学习细胞坐标、连续RNA轨迹和调控动力学。未剪接和剪接RNA轨迹的导数与转录-剪接-降解动力学相匹配，包括在观测细胞之间，使表达重建、细胞排序和动力学估计相互 informing。ManifoldVelo在所有评估的单细胞轨迹类型中恢复伪时间，包括循环、多分支和光滑非分支轨迹。ManifoldVelo在多峰循环模拟中在所比较方法中实现最佳伪时间恢复，并在多峰循环和分支模拟中实现剪接RNA速率最高方向一致性。真实数据分析支持跨实验板的相位预测，以及与胰腺发育阶段和标记表达一致的分化轨迹。其核心优势在于在可复用的动态参考中联合恢复不同轨迹结构中的时间位置和局部动力学。新细胞仅从剪接RNA即可获得伪时间和速率预测，无需重新拟

extra.description: Jointly recovering pseudotime and RNA velocity from static single-cell transcriptomes requires reconciling global trajectory structure with local expression changes, particularly in complex cycles and branching differentiation. Here we introduce ManifoldVelo, a topology-conditioned framework that jointly learns cellular coordinates, continuous RNA trajectories and regulatory kinetics. Derivatives of unspliced and spliced RNA trajectories are matched to transcription-splicing-degradation dynamics, including between observed cells, allowing expression reconstruction, cellular ordering and kinetic estimation to inform one another. ManifoldVelo recovers pseudotime across all evaluated single-cell trajectory types, including cyclic, multibranch and smooth non-branching trajectories. ManifoldVelo achieves the best pseudotime recovery among compared methods in multipeak cyclic simulations and the highest directional agreement for spliced RNA velocity in both multipeak cyclic and branching simulations. Real-data analyses support phase prediction across experimental plates and differentiation trajectories consistent with pancreatic developmental stages and marker expression. Its central advantage is the joint recovery of temporal position and local dynamics across distinct trajectory structures within a reusable dynamic reference. New cells are assigned pseudotime and velocity predictions from spliced RNA alone, without refitting the reference model. ManifoldVelo provides a foundation for dynamic cell atlases that transfer learned temporal and kinetic information to new samples.

items.title: Kolmogorov-Chapman Maps: Trajectory-Free Learning for Simulating Molecular Dynamics
items.title_zh: Kolmogorov-Chapman映射：用于模拟分子动力学的无轨迹学习
items.summary_zh: 随机微分方程（SDE）描述了跨越物理学、生物学和金融学等广泛科学领域的随机过程。虽然单个数值积分步骤成本低廉，但观察有意义的事件或转变可能需要数百万个顺序步骤，导致大量挂钟模拟时间和硬件利用率低下。深度学习提供了一种替代方案，通过将许多积分步骤摊销到单个神经网络前向传递中，可能实现更快的模拟。然而，现有的监督方法通常需要长时间模拟的轨迹数据，这限制了它们的适用性。在这项工作中，我们引入了Kolmogorov-Chapman映射（KC-Maps），一种学习SDE转移核的方法，仅依赖于无轨迹的边缘样本以及已知的漂移和扩散系数。给定过程的初始时间和状态，KC-Maps对其积分到任意给定时间的分布进行建模，对应于SDE的弱解。为了恢复正确的动力学，KC-Maps满足两个关键性质：（i）它满足边界条件，我们将其直接纳入神经网络架构；（ii）它遵守Kolmogorov-Chapman方程，这提供了高效

extra.description: Stochastic differential equations (SDEs) describe stochastic processes across a wide range of scientific domains, including physics, biology, and finance. Although individual numerical integration steps are inexpensive, observing meaningful events or transitions can require millions of sequential steps, resulting in substantial wall-clock simulation time and poor hardware utilization. Deep learning offers an alternative by amortizing many integration steps into a single neural network forward pass, potentially enabling much faster simulation. However, existing supervised approaches typically require long simulated trajectory data, which restricts their applicability. In this work, we introduce Kolmogorov-Chapman Maps (KC-Maps), a method for learning the transition kernel of an SDE that relies only on the trajectory-free marginal samples together with the known drift and diffusion coefficients. Given an initial time and state of a process, KC-Maps models its distribution integrated to any given time, corresponding to the weak solution of the SDE. To recover the correct dynamics, KC-Maps satisfies two key properties: (i) it satisfies the boundary conditions, which we incorporate directly into the neural network architecture, and (ii) it respects the Kolmogorov--Chapman equation, which provides an efficient training objective. We empirically demonstrate that KC-Maps learns to integrate the dynamics of peptide molecular systems and outperforms classical molecular dynamics in terms of GPU-hours.

items.title: HiVe-Mem: Interleaving Horizontal Memory Expansion and Vertical Evidence Composition for Multimodal Agents
items.title_zh: HiVe-Mem：交织水平记忆扩展和垂直证据组合用于多模态智能体
items.summary_zh: 随着多模态智能体积累越来越长的交互历史，有效检索和利用过去信息对于长期交互变得至关重要。现有的记忆系统通常依赖于对压缩记忆的语义检索，并暴露预定义的表示，这可能遗漏相关记忆，并忽视跨查询的异构证据需求。我们介绍了HiVe-Mem，一个多模态记忆框架，交织水平记忆扩展与垂直证据组合。对于水平记忆扩展，HiVe-Mem使用文本和视觉锚点将记忆片段组织成关系图，用相关邻居扩展语义检索的种子以恢复互补信息。对于垂直证据组合，每个检索到的记忆保留多种证据形式，包括紧凑摘要、字幕、接地视觉视图、原始图像和交互历史。一个轻量级可训练选择器为每个检索到的记忆独立组合证据子集，实现异构多模态信息的查询自适应利用。这种二维设计共同拓宽了记忆覆盖范围，并适应了单个记忆贡献的证据。在三个多模态记忆基准上的实验表明，HiVe-Mem持续提高基础模型的任务性能，同时与最高效的竞争多模态基线相比，token消耗减少约9

extra.description: As multimodal agents accumulate increasingly long interaction histories, effectively retrieving and utilizing past information becomes critical for long-term interaction. Existing memory systems typically rely on semantic retrieval over compressed memories and expose predefined representations, which may miss relevant memories and overlook heterogeneous evidence needs across queries. We introduce \textbf{\hivemem}, a multimodal memory framework that interleaves \textbf{\textsc{H}}or\textbf{\textsc{i}}zontal Memory Expansion with \textbf{\textsc{Ve}}rtical Evidence Composition. For horizontal memory expansion, \hivemem organizes memory episodes into a relational graph using textual and visual anchors, expanding semantically retrieved seeds with related neighbors to recover complementary information. For vertical evidence composition, each retrieved memory retains multiple evidence forms, including compact summaries, captions, grounded visual views, raw images, and interaction history. A lightweight trainable selector independently composes an evidence subset for each retrieved memory, enabling query-adaptive utilization of heterogeneous multimodal information. This two-dimensional design jointly broadens memory coverage and adapts the evidence contributed by individual memories. Experiments across three multimodal memory benchmarks show that \hivemem consistently improves task performance across base models while reducing token consumption by about 90\% compared with the most efficient competing multimodal baselines.

items.title: Vendi Anomaly Scores for Efficient and Accurate Anomaly Detection
items.title_zh: Vendi异常分数用于高效准确的异常检测
items.summary_zh: 异常检测（AD）对于可信机器学习和科学发现至关重要。现有方法通常通过局部密度、隔离启发式或与拟合分布的距离来定义异常，使其对邻域尺度、分区选择或限制性分布假设敏感。在这项工作中，我们通过从多样性角度制定异常检测引入了一种新范式。我们提出了Vendi异常分数（VAS），它通过量化样本被移除时数据集多样性（由Vendi分数衡量）的变化程度来检测异常。VAS捕捉局部冗余和全局数据结​​构，而不依赖于密度估计或分区启发式。此外，VAS无需超参数调优，而是自动适应数据的谱结构。VAS是非参数的，并且随数据集大小线性扩展。在来自10个源数据集和4种嵌入架构的148个基准嵌入数据集上，VAS实现了最先进的AD性能。我们进一步在大规模ImageNet实验中验证了VAS，随着污染率和数据集规模的增加，它保持鲁棒。

extra.description: Anomaly detection (AD) is a critical for trustworthy machine learning and scientific discovery. Existing methods typically define anomalies through local density, isolation heuristics, or distance from a fitted distribution, making them sensitive to neighborhood scale, partitioning choices, or restrictive distributional assumptions. In this work, we introduce a new paradigm by formulating anomaly detection from a diversity perspective. We propose the $\textit{Vendi Anomaly Score}$ (VAS), which detects anomalies by quantifying how much a sample changes the diversity of the dataset, as measured by the Vendi score, when removed. VAS captures both local redundancy and global data structure without relying on density estimation or partitioning heuristics. Moreover, VAS requires no hyperparameter tuning, instead adapting automatically to the spectral structure of the data. VAS is non-parametric and scales linearly with dataset size. Across 148 benchmark embedding datasets derived from 10 source datasets and 4 embedding architectures, VAS achieves state-of-the-art AD performance. We further validate VAS on large-scale ImageNet experiments, where it remains robust as both contamination rate and dataset scale increase.

items.title: PREMISE: A Quality-Aware Probabilistic Framework for High-Resolution Source Assignment in Metagenomic Sequencing
items.title_zh: PREMISE：一个用于宏基因组测序中高分辨率来源分配的质量感知概率框架
items.summary_zh: 宏基因组应用，从甲型流感病毒（IAV）亚型追踪到细菌菌株分辨率，经常需要亚种分辨率。然而，传统的基于k-mer的方法将reads片段化为短k-mer并丢弃每个碱基的质量分数。通过省略read内连锁和错误信息，这些方法混淆了密切相关的基因组变异，从而阻碍了实时病原体监测和遏制。我们介绍了PREMISE（通过测序实验中的期望最大化进行病原体解析），一个用Rust实现的概率、基于比对的框架，用于针对近乎完整的参考数据库进行高分辨率来源分配。PREMISE使用双向游程编码FM索引比对整个reads，并使用映射到分类学上的质量感知期望最大化算法量化参考丰度。该框架应用可选的稀疏惩罚来解决模糊分配，这在稀疏样本映射到富含高度同源候选参考的参考数据库时尤为重要。在十个密集CAMI II菌株疯狂样本上，PREMISE在八种评估方法中实现了最高的物种级read分类F1分数（0.992），没有假阳性或遗漏物种

extra.description: Metagenomic applications, from influenza A virus (IAV) subtype tracking to bacterial strain resolution, frequently require sub-species resolution.However, traditional $k$-mer-based methods fragment reads into short $k$-mers and discard per-base quality scores.By omitting both intra-read linkage and error information, these methods confound closely related genomic variants, thereby impeding real-time pathogen surveillance and containment.We introduce \premise (Pathogen Resolution via Expectation-Maximization In Sequencing Experiments), a probabilistic, alignment-based framework implemented in Rust for high-resolution source assignment against near-complete reference databases.\premise aligns whole reads using a bidirectional run-length FM-index and quantifies reference abundances with a quality-aware Expectation-Maximization algorithm mapped over a taxonomy.This framework applies an optional sparsity penalty to resolve ambiguous assignments, which is particularly important when sparse samples are mapped against reference databases rich in highly homologous candidate references.On ten dense CAMI II strain-madness samples, \premise achieves the highest species-level read classification F1 score ($0.992$) among eight evaluated methods, with no false-positive or missed species.At the strain level, \premise maps reads to their source genome with top precision ($0.80$ vs. at most $0.64$ for competing methods), achieves 100\% recall, and estimates abundances as accurately as the best competing tool.These results demonstrate \premise's ability to provide rigorous, uncertainty-aware source resolution across both dense and sparse metagenomes, accurately resolving targets ranging from viral subtypes to bacterial strains.\\textbf{Availability:} \url{https://github.com/sriram98v/premise} under an MIT license.\\textbf{Contact:} \href{sriramv@iastate.edu}{sriramv@iastate.edu}\\

items.title: A three-factor model can explain symmetry breaking and the n-1 rule during X-chromosome inactivation
items.title_zh: 三因子模型可以解释X染色体失活过程中的对称性破缺和n-1规则
items.summary_zh: X染色体失活（XCI）是一种哺乳动物基因调控过程，通过染色体规模的转录沉默，在每个二倍体基因组补体中留下一条活跃的X染色体。使细胞能够选择适当数量的X染色体失活同时保持其他活跃的机制仍不清楚。我们证明，XCI过程中所有已知的染色体计数场景都可以由一个三因子数学模型解释，该模型包括（1）Xist，负责真兽类XCI过程中基因沉默的长非编码RNA（lncRNA），（2）Xist的X连锁转录激活因子，以及（3）常染色体编码的SPEN，一种Xist RNA结合蛋白，对XCI过程中的基因沉默至关重要。在我们的模型中，活跃X染色体之间的对称性被XCI开始时与X染色体结合的Xist分子数量的随机差异所打破。随后，整合的正反馈和负反馈环路放大然后传播与Xist复合的SPEN的超化学计量组装到失活染色体上，并选择X连锁激活因子的水平，使得每个二倍体基因组补体中只有一条X染色体保持活跃。因此，SPEN-Xist

extra.description: X-chromosome inactivation (XCI) is a mammalian gene regulatory process that via chromosome-scale transcriptional silencing, leaves active a single X chromosome per diploid genome complement. The mechanisms that enable cells to select the appropriate number of X chromosomes to inactivate while leaving others active remain unclear. We demonstrate that all known chromosomal counting scenarios during XCI can be accounted for by a three-factor mathematical model that includes (1) Xist, the long noncoding RNA (lncRNA) responsible for gene silencing during XCI in eutherians, (2) an X-linked transcriptional activator of Xist, and (3) the autosomally-encoded SPEN, an Xist RNA-binding protein that is essential for gene silencing during XCI. In our model, symmetry between active X chromosomes is broken by stochastic differences in the number of Xist molecules that associate with the X chromosomes at the onset of XCI. Subsequently, integrated positive and negative feedback loops amplify then propagate superstoichiometric assemblies of SPEN complexed with Xist on the inactive chromosome(s), and select for levels of X-linked activator that enable only one X chromosome per diploid genome complement to remain active. Thus, asymmetric propagation of the SPEN-Xist ribonucleoprotein complex may play an essential role in symmetry breaking and chromosomal counting during XCI, independently of or in concert with cis-acting networks of DNA regulatory elements. Our results also have conceptual implications for gene regulatory circuits on autosomes.

items.title: Dual regulation of chemical stress-induced DDI2/3 expression by a transcription factor Fzf1 and nucleosome in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
items.title_zh: 酿酒酵母中转录因子Fzf1和核小体对化学应激诱导的DDI2/3表达的双重调控
items.summary_zh: DDI2和DDI3（DDI2/3）是酿酒酵母中的重复基因，在氰胺（CY）和甲基甲磺酸（MMS）等化学处理下，通过转录因子Fzf1表现出强烈的诱导。尽管与DDI2/3一样，SSU1、YHB1和YNR064C也含有Fzf1结合共有序列CS2并受Fzf1协调调控，但这些基因仅被CY和MMS适度诱导。为了鉴定DDI2/3启动子中的额外顺式作用元件，我们在报告系统中制作了DDI2/3启动子缺失，并鉴定了跨越480个核苷酸的上游阻遏序列（URS）。为了检验染色质结构构成URS的假设，我们利用了一种能够通过切换碳源消耗组蛋白H3/H4的酵母菌株。组蛋白消耗后，DDI2/3以Fzf1依赖的方式被强烈诱导，而YHB1被抑制。有趣的是，在组蛋白消耗条件下，CY或MMS处理进一步以Fzf1依赖的方式将所有Fzf1调控基因的表达增加到相当水平。全基因组MNase-seq分析显示，CY处理降低了野生型细胞中映射的D

extra.description: DDI2 and DDI3 (DDI2/3) are duplicated genes in Saccharomyces cerevisiae that exhibit strong induction by a transcription factor Fzf1 in response to chemical treatments like cyanamide (CY) and methyl methanesulfonate (MMS). Although, like DDI2/3, SSU1, YHB1 and YNR064C also contain an Fzf1-binding consensus sequence CS2 and are coordinately regulated by Fzf1, these genes are only modestly induced by CY and MMS. To identify additional cis-acting elements in the DDI2/3 promoter, we made DDI2/3 promoter deletions in a reporter system and identified upstream repressing sequences (URS) spanning 480 nucleotides. To test a hypothesis that the chromatin structure constitutes the URS, we utilized a yeast strain capable of histone H3/H4 depletion by shifting carbon sources. Following histone depletion, DDI2/3 were strongly induced in an Fzf1 dependent manner, while YHB1 was repressed. Interestingly, under histone depletion conditions, CY or MMS treatment further increased expression of all Fzf1-regulated genes to comparable levels in an Fzf1 dependent manner. A genome-wide MNase-seq analysis showed that CY treatment reduced the nucleosome occupancy at the mapped DDI2/3 URS region in wild-type cells, but not in in fzf1{Delta} cells. These findings collectively indicate that Fzf1 plays dual roles in regulating the DDI2/3 response to CY. Firstly, it binds CS2 and serves as a transcription activator. Secondly, it is required for the chromatin remodeling at URS. This two-tier regulation at the DDI2/3 promoter helps to explain why DDI2/3 achieve much higher fold induction by CY and MMS than other Fzf1-regulated genes, suggesting Fzf1 to be a candidate pioneer transcription factor.

items.title: ER stress-associated IRE1α signalling links impaired QPRT-dependent NAD⁺ biosynthesis to reduced oocyte competence
items.title_zh: ER应激相关的IRE1α信号将受损的QPRT依赖性NAD⁺生物合成与降低的卵母细胞能力联系起来
items.summary_zh: 卵母细胞质量与代谢和细胞器稳态密切相关，但自然发生的卵母细胞质量差异的潜在机制仍不完全清楚。在这里，我们确定了内质网（ER）应激、NAD生物合成受损和卵母细胞质量差之间的联系。劣质山羊卵母细胞表现出深刻的NAD耗竭，伴随着喹啉酸积累和喹啉酸磷酸核糖转移酶（QPRT）表达降低，表明从头NAD生物合成存在瓶颈。恢复QPRT表达或绕过这一代谢步骤改善了减数分裂成熟。进一步分析揭示了ER应激信号改变、IRE1相关活性增加和QPRT RNA稳定性降低。重组IRE1在体外加工QPRT RNA，表明IRE1活性与QPRT转录本调控之间可能存在联系。补充烟酰胺单核苷酸（NMN）恢复了NAD水平并改善了劣质卵母细胞的几个特征，包括钙稳态、氧化应激和线粒体膜电位。NMN处理还改善了早期胚胎发育，其有益效果涉及SIRT6活性和DNA甲基化相关荧光的变化。重要的是，NMN补充改善了劣质牛和猪卵母细胞的减数分裂成熟

extra.description: Oocyte quality is closely linked to metabolic and organelle homeostasis, but the mechanisms underlying naturally occurring differences in oocyte quality remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify a link between endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress, impaired NAD biosynthesis and poor oocyte quality. Poor-grade goat oocytes exhibited profound NAD depletion, accompanied by quinolinic acid accumulation and reduced expression of quinolinate phosphoribosyltransferase (QPRT), suggesting a bottleneck in de novo NAD biosynthesis. Restoring QPRT expression or bypassing this metabolic step improved meiotic maturation. Further analyses revealed altered ER stress signalling, increased IRE1-associated activity and reduced QPRT RNA stability. Recombinant IRE1 processed QPRT RNA in vitro, suggesting a possible link between IRE1 activity and QPRT transcript regulation. Supplementation with nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) restored NAD levels and improved several features of poor-quality oocytes, including calcium homeostasis, oxidative stress and mitochondrial membrane potential. NMN treatment also improved early embryonic development, with its beneficial effects involving SIRT6 activity and changes in DNA methylation-associated fluorescence. Importantly, NMN supplementation improved meiotic maturation in poor-grade bovine and porcine oocytes, indicating that this metabolic intervention may have broader relevance across mammals. Analysis of published human oocyte proteomic data further revealed age-associated changes in ER proteostasis and NAD-related proteins. Together, our findings identify ER stress-associated disruption of QPRT-dependent NAD biosynthesis as a potential contributor to poor oocyte quality and suggest that restoring NAD metabolism may offer a strategy to improve the functional properties of compromised oocytes.

items.summary_zh: Nature Methods，在线发表：2026年11月5日；doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03338-w 推出AI Bytes，这是Nature Methods的新教育专栏，旨在为生命科学研究群体简化人工智能中的技术概念。

extra.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 05 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03338-w Introducing AI Bytes, a new educational column at Nature Methods that aims to simplify technical concepts in artificial intelligence for the life sciences research community.
